value.rationale: The natural q11 order-five even characters provide the first small testbed where two nonconjugate character classes yield identical pairwise EITFF angles yet provably different higher-order worst erasure behavior. This finite exact classification computes all 330 quartet Gram spectra, separate sharp four-block restricted-isometry constants, a qualitative switch between 110 and 55 extremal quartets, and full independence for each quartet. Such higher-order stability data are not dictated by equi-isoclinism and are concretely motivated by block-sparse reconstruction.
